query: 产品安全政策 产品安全政策 衡量企业在产品设计、原材料采购、生产测试、上市后监测及召回等全生命周期中的安全管理机制。重点考察预防性设计、质量监测频率及产品安全责任的归属与闭环机制。 一、内容质量得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（卓越）：具备“本质安全”设计准则；执行严于行业标准的内部测试；建立了主动的上市后安全监测（PMS）系统；具备明确的缺陷产品召回规程及高层负责的责任机制。 • 1分（合格）：建立了基础的质量管理体系（如 ISO 9001），具备标准化的出厂检测流程和被动的客户投诉处理机制，但缺乏全生命周期的预防性监控或明确的召回演练。 • 0分（不合格）：无正式产品安全政策披露，或仅有笼统的“质量至上”表述。 二、覆盖应用得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（高覆盖）：安全管理机制覆盖 >80% 的产品线、在售品项或业务收入，核心实体通过了行业特定的质量认证（如 IATF 16949, ISO 13485）。 • 1分（部分覆盖）：占比 >0% - 80%，或仅核心产品具备完整策略，或未说明具体覆盖比例。 • 0分（无覆盖）：无相关覆盖范围信息。 产品安全政策 产品质量管理 本质安全设计 产品测试 上市后监测 缺陷管理 质量认证 产品安全责任 ISO 9001 PMS ISO 13485 product safety policy product quality management design for safety product testing post-market surveillance PMS defect management ISO 9001 product liability ISO 13485 是否有覆盖产品设计、原材料采购、生产测试、上市后监测及召回的产品安全或质量管理政策？ 是否披露本质安全设计、FMEA等风险分析或内部测试？ 是否有标准化出厂检测和客户投诉处理？ 是否建立上市后安全监测、批次追溯及缺陷召回责任机制？ 机制覆盖多少产品线、在售品项或业务收入？ 核心实体取得哪些质量认证？
instruction: Assess whether the passage provides concrete evidence for the ESG indicator '产品安全政策'. Prefer explicit, auditable disclosure that answers: 是否有覆盖产品设计、原材料采购、生产测试、上市后监测及召回的产品安全或质量管理政策？ 是否披露本质安全设计、FMEA等风险分析或内部测试？ 是否有标准化出厂检测和客户投诉处理？ 是否建立上市后安全监测、批次追溯及缺陷召回责任机制？ 机制覆盖多少产品线、在售品项或业务收入？ 核心实体取得哪些质量认证？ Exclude or down-rank: 排除：仅有“质量至上”口号；仅有召回率数字而无制度；仅有负责任营销准则；仅有客户满意度调查；区分：产品安全政策关注全生命周期安全管理机制；召回程序关注召回制度与通知追踪；产品回收率是召回数量占比统计，不是政策本身。 Preserve relevant tables, notes, units, limitations, policies, targets, methods and coverage details.

results.section: Quality and Reliable Service / ‧ Improving terminal security
results.text: Terminal security is a major focus area of the Group for maintaining the security of shipping containers and cargoes. To control security risks and cargo safety, we set up security infrastructures and deploy security teams at the cargo terminals. In the cargo terminals, site perimeter fencing, security gates, security lighting are installed. The check-in and check-out processes of personnel and vehicles are strictly guarded as well as the site patrolling. Moreover, the security of terminals is monitored by installing the surveillance cameras system.
results.retrieval_text:
[Section]
Quality and Reliable Service / ‧ Improving terminal security

[Content]
Terminal security is a major focus area of the Group for maintaining the security of shipping containers and cargoes. To control security risks and cargo safety, we set up security infrastructures and deploy security teams at the cargo terminals. In the cargo terminals, site perimeter fencing, security gates, security lighting are installed. The check-in and check-out processes of personnel and vehicles are strictly guarded as well as the site patrolling. Moreover, the security of terminals is monitored by installing the surveillance cameras system.

results.section: Safety and Health / Passenger and Crew Safety
results.text: The Group has a strong responsibility towards our passengers and employees to ensure safety on ferries and ships. We have formulated and implemented the Safety Management Manual for Ships and other standards and guidelines to guide employees on daily maintenance and inspection to ensure the proper functioning and safe operation of ferries and ships. We also provide instructions on how to manage and respond to scenarios such as severe weather conditions and fires to subsidiaries under the passenger transportation business, so as to eliminate potential risks and ensure safe operation of ferries, ships and cruise ship. In order to enhance the contingency preparedness and situational awareness of the subsidiaries under the passenger transportation business, we conduct emergency exercises simulation exercises are regularly conducted such as spill collision, stranding of ferry and hull damage simulation. Safety training is carried out periodically to foster a safety awareness culture and to ensure that the Group's safety standards are communicated effectively. During the Reporting Period, there was no case of significant safety accident in passenger transportation.

We have formulated and implemented the Safety Management Manual for Ships and other standards and guidelines to guide employees on daily maintenance and inspection to ensure the proper functioning and safe operation of ferries and ships. We also provide instructions on how to manage and respond to scenarios such as severe weather conditions and fires to subsidiaries under the passenger transportation business, so as to eliminate potential risks and ensure safe operation of ferries, ships and cruise ship. In order to enhance the contingency preparedness and situational awareness of the subsidiaries under the passenger transportation business, we conduct emergency exercises simulation exercises are regularly conducted such as spill collision, stranding of ferry and hull damage simulation. Safety training is carried out periodically to foster a safety awareness culture and to ensure that the Group's safety standards are communicated effectively. During the Reporting Period, there was no case of significant safety accident in passenger transportation.
